verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the document-template behavior that every report page must use a clean, consistent footer containing specified report information.
The immediately preceding question resolves all four PDF variants, and the client requires the same report design, including its recurring footer, across RR01–RR04.
First concrete verification: the client reviewed the revised report and explicitly reported that its footer was working well.
Distinct post-verification failure: the reviewed report retains the footer on pages 1–3 but omits it from page 4.
The client adds a concrete final-page layout condition: the standard footer must coexist with the distribution warning without visual conflict.
